summary: The PY geometry and materials are unchanged since w19: all eight studio views (p1-p8) are pixel-identical to w19 (0 changed px). The w18 high, the black-cord seam bead, stays fixed. On the head q14 foreground seat the bead's per-row minimum L is within 1-3 L of w19 (row 350: w19 '31 36 40 64', head '30 35 39 63'), and the bead's width profile over y 165-575 is the same, so the shader change did not make the seam bead read too dark. Fabric contrast is unchanged (q14 mid back L sd 32.2 -> 32.1; q13 front back 27.0 -> 26.9), and so is the thin-dark detail (q13 3.95 -> 3.92 %, q14 5.84 -> 5.85 %, by my own 7-px-median metric). The one new effect is a cool colour cast from the new lighting. Mean luminance of the PY materials is unchanged (within 2 L), but B-R rises by 10-13 on the fabric, shell and console. The fabric's B/R moves from 1.27 (w19), which matched py_37301/37303 (1.25), to 1.39. So in the cabin views the cloth reads a slightly too-blue denim instead of the photo's blue-grey. This comes from lighting, not from the PY materials. The w17 cushion-front band medium is still open (p5/p8 are identical). The score is 8.5: one notch below my w19 8.6 for the fabric hue drift in q13/q14, and still at the pass line on geometry, proportion and materials.
lighting_note: Not scored in PY, but it is the main change since w19. The head mood/shader change adds a blue cast with no change in luminance. On the q14 mid seat-back fabric (x 250-400, y 300-500) mean RGB goes from (114.5,124.8,145.1) to (110.9,124.0,154.1), B-R 30.6 -> 43.1. On the q13 front-seat fabric (x 200-340, y 420-560), B-R goes 35.3 -> 47.4. On the q14 foreground shell, 24.5 -> 33.9. On the q13 console, 24.3 -> 37.2. On the q14 window reveal, L 174 -> 163 and B-R 13 -> 21. As a ratio, fabric (B-R)/L goes 0.25 -> 0.35 against 0.23 in py_37301 (back fabric, mean (146.5,159.8,183.2)). The shell stays inside the photo range (B/R 1.37, against 1.20 for the rear shell in py_37303 and 1.38 for the arm side in py_37301). The bead still darkens to L 16-32 in the shaded bottom 35 px of q14 (photo junction about L 60), the same as w19.

The head lighting is neutral for the seam bead and for fabric contrast, but it pushes the fabric hue bluer than the official photos. The lighting owner should trim the cool tint. PY itself needs no change for this.
